name: Lemon-Garlic Marinated Shrimp
desc: Cooked shrimp tossed in warm garlic oil with lemon and parsley and served cold.

source.title: Lemon-Garlic Marinated Shrimp
source.evidence: Identical ingredient list and amounts (3 tbsp garlic, 2 tbsp oil, 1/4 cup each lemon and parsley, 1/2 tsp each salt and pepper, 1 1/4 lb cooked shrimp) and the same skillet method, nearly word for word.

ingredients.raw: 1/4 cup fresh lemon juice (from 1 to 2 lemons)
1 1/4 lb cooked large shrimp, peeled and deveined, thawed if frozen
ingredients.prep: peeled and deveined, thawed if frozen

steps: Put the garlic and oil in a small skillet over medium heat and cook, stirring, until fragrant, about 1 minute. Do not let it brown.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the lemon juice, parsley, salt, and pepper.
Toss the dressing with the shrimp in a large bowl. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes and up to 2 hours before serving.
tips: Serve cold as an appetizer with toothpicks, or over greens.
